name: traceflow-monitor
description: Watches, configures and launches TraceFlow experiments for every project in master.yaml. Private; never published.
author: Shraddha Mishra

commands.title: Status page: a read-only view of the runs in any browser, a desktop's or a phone's (saved to its home screen it opens like an app), and a link with a QR code for each person you share it with

traceflow.root.description: Path to the TraceFlow repository. Empty: the workspace folder that holds services/side_channel_core/config/master.yaml.

traceflow.env.description: Empty (default): follow the commands: the running run's ENV, a queue's ENV= lines, else the latest run's. Set (dev, staging, prod) only to force one.

traceflow.python.description: Interpreter for the panel's helpers. Empty: the sca conda env's python if present, else python3.

traceflow.pollSeconds.description: Seconds between reads of the heartbeat and the run registry.
